metaDescription: Order custom 50-inch umbrellas in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for outdoor promotions. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom 50-inch umbrellas offer generous coverage for outdoor events, trade shows, and corporate giveaways. Unlike compact travel umbrellas, this larger size provides real shade and rain protection for multiple people, making them ideal for golf outings, stadium events, or employee appreciation gifts. Choose full-color imprint on the canopy to maximize brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom 50-inch umbrella with full-color imprint on the canopy, ideal for outdoor events and bulk orders
